name: Indian & Forest Acres Camps
description_short: Brother and sister overnight camps in Fryeburg, Maine, for ages 7 to 17: Indian Acres for boys and Forest Acres for girls, two miles apart near the Saco River. Campers do water sports, horseback riding, team sports, arts and trips in 4 or 7 week sessions.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2027 dates and tuition. Transportation from Boston, Westchester/CT, Newton/Newport and Portland is booked through the office and billed on top of tuition. Rookie Camp is free per the Forest Acres page.
